name: Disaster risk and response coordination
summary: A recurring global harm area where OSS can plausibly reduce friction in mapping, damage assessment, volunteer coordination, interoperability, early warning, and post-disaster recovery workflows.

metrics.claim: UNDRR's 2024 Annual Report says 163 member states reported in the Sendai Framework Monitor and 112 reported disaster losses in DesInventar, indicating substantial public disaster-risk data infrastructure.

UNDRR's 2024 Annual Report describes national disaster-risk strategies and infrastructure-resilience work, but this record does not yet include a global mortality or affected-population burden estimate.

software_pathways.claim: Likely OSS pathways include HOT, Crisis Cleanup, IFRC and hazard-data libraries, GIS imports, offline mapping, volunteer workflows, and standards interoperability; candidates need current issue and maintainer evidence.
